snippet.title: SUCKS TO BE IN THE STICKS (Official Demo Trailer)
snippet.description:
Sucks To Be In The Sticks - Demo is out on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665100/Sucks_To_Be_In_The_Sticks/

An interview with a vampire from a decaying post-Soviet town. A cursed life simulator: scrub floors, brew moonshine, follow strange routines - and drink blood as your sanity unravels. The world is broken. Can you find out why?
